facts.fact: A field epidemiology training programme survey of 17 April to 19 May 2023 found 71 of 215 randomly sampled public health centres (33.0%), from a frame of 491, using an electronic medical record system; 39 of those 71 used OpenMRS (Uwambajimana et al., preprint).

The same 2023 survey found all 42 district hospitals using an electronic medical record system, 35 of them OpenMRS, against 71 of 215 sampled health centres; referral hospitals and health posts were not surveyed.

systems.tiers: 35 of 42 district hospitals (2 more with OpenClinics); 39 of 71 EMR-using health centres alone and 6 more beside another system (2023)
